vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tv
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a straightforward implementation for querying TV program schedules via the Jisu Data API (api.jisuapi.com). The Python script (tv.py) correctly handles environment variables for authentication and performs standard HTTP GET requests without any signs of data exfiltration, command injection, or obfuscation.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose: it calls the Jisu TV API and only requires a JISU_API_KEY and python3; no unexplained credentials, hidden endpoints, or persistence are present.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the code and instructions: the skill queries Jisu TV endpoints and lists channels. Declared requirements (python3, JISU_API_KEY) align with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running the included Python script and setting JISU_API_KEY. The instructions only reference the API, channel/query flows, and the environment variable; they do not request unrelated files, credentials, or external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) which minimizes install risk. One inconsistency: tv.py imports the third‑party Python package 'requests' but the metadata/README only lists 'python3' as a required binary and doesn't mention installing the 'requests' package. This is an availability/usability issue (script will fail if requests is absent) rather than a security red flag. No downloads or unknown URLs are used; network calls go to the documented api.jisuapi.com domain.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only JISU_API_KEY is required and used. That credential is proportional to the skill's function (it is sent as the 'appkey' parameter to the documented API). No other secrets or unrelated env vars are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill does not request always:true or any special persistence; it does not modify other skills or system-wide settings. It runs on demand and makes outbound API calls as expected.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do exactly what it says: call the Jisu TV API to list channels or query schedules. Before installing: 1) Ensure you trust the Jisu API provider and are comfortable granting it the JISU_API_KEY (the key will be sent to api.jisuapi.com as the 'appkey' parameter). 2) The Python script uses the 'requests' library but the metadata doesn't mention installing it — install requests (pip install requests) or ensure your environment includes it. 3) Be aware of rate limits or billing associated with your Jisu API key and avoid sharing the key. 4) If you want extra caution, inspect the included tv.py file (it is short and readable) and/or run it in an isolated environment. There are no other hidden endpoints or unrelated credential accesses detected.
